evidence.quote: 原作コミックス11巻限定版に収録された第23話の全23話を収録

special_episode_count.reason: The OAD is identified as a single episode titled '#23 MOMENTS' (or 'MOMENTS'), which serves as the 23rd episode in the total count when added to the 22 TV episodes. It is a single short film/OAD, not a multi-episode series.

evidence.quote: 2015年5月15日に発売のコミックス最終11巻限定版に同梱!

special_release_date.reason: The OAD 'MOMENTS' was released as a bonus for the limited edition of the 11th volume of the manga on May 15, 2015. While a BD-BOX containing it was released in 2020, the initial release of the OAD itself was in 2015.

answer.identity_notes: The target is the OAD 'MOMENTS' (Episode 23), which is distinct from the 22-episode TV series. It was originally released on DVD bundled with the 11th volume of the manga on 2015-05-15. It was later included in the BD-BOX released on 2020-04-01. The count of special episodes is 1.
